infoBoxes.mapQuery: 層雲峡温泉 上川町

notes: The ice fall festival is a seasonal event on a temporary site on the Ishikari River bank in 層雲峡温泉, not a permanent facility. If Google Maps doesn't return the venue for '層雲峡温泉氷瀑まつり 上川町' outside the festival season, fall back to '層雲峡温泉 上川町'. Official link is the 層雲峡観光協会 festival site.
